headline: 《怒之杀》霸榜热搜，今日零新片上映
headlineEn: Fury Kill tops trending; no new releases today
summary: 今日（8月23日）暂无新片上映，本周共有4部新片入市。动作科幻题材持续霸榜，《怒之杀》同时领跑今日与本周热搜；《死神》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《玩具总动员5》《特别行动：母狮》等热度紧随。备受期待的《最后的日出》即将登场。
summaryEn: No new films opened today (Aug 23), with four new releases hitting theaters this week. Action and sci-fi titles dominate: Fury Kill tops both daily and weekly trends, followed by Death, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Toy Story 5, and Special Ops: Lioness. Anticipated The Last Sunrise is coming soon.

industryHighlights.text: 今日0部新片上映，本周共4部新片入市。
industryHighlights.en: Zero new theatrical releases today; four new films hit theaters this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《怒之杀》同时登顶今日与本周热搜。
industryHighlights.en: Fury Kill ranks No.1 in both today's and weekly trending.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》《奥德赛》等影片本周热搜在榜。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps and The Odyssey are also on this week's trending chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《潜伏6：血域》《侠探杰克》同样受到关注。
industryHighlights.en: Insidious 6: Blood Domain and Jack Reacher also draw attention.

industryHighlights.text: 新片《最后的日出》备受期待，即将上映。
industryHighlights.en: The upcoming film The Last Sunrise is highly anticipated.
